methods.name: Stage-Progression
methods.rationale: Applies typical Growth → next-stage step-up multiplier (1.2x) to $50M total raised proxy.

data.narrative:
Orbital Marine Power is a growth-stage ocean and maritime technology company that has raised $50M+ to date. The comparable universe for this sector is limited, comprising one identified private peer (Ocean Infinity) and no directly comparable public companies, reflecting the nascent and capital-intensive nature of frontier marine technologies.

The valuation analysis applies a stage-progression methodology, which is the applicable triangulation approach given data constraints. Using total capital raised of $50M as a baseline proxy and applying a typical 1.2x step-up multiplier for progression from Growth stage to the next funding round yields an implied valuation of $60M. This reflects standard risk-adjusted returns expected at this development stage without relying on speculative revenue multiples or comparable transaction data.

The triangulated valuation range is $51M to $69M, with a median of $60M. The narrow methodological set—one applicable approach—and limited peer visibility create material uncertainty around this estimate. Key variables affecting valuation include technology maturation status, path to commercialization, and competitive positioning relative to Ocean Infinity and other emerging market entrants. The absence of public comparables and transaction precedent in this subsector constrains confidence in the range. Investors should require additional operational and market validation before committing capital at valuations toward the higher end of this band.
